an7.71:1.1: bhāvanaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an7.71:1.2: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti
an7.71:1.3: athakhvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccata
an7.71:1.7: catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa
an7.71:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
an7.71:2.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammāadhisayitāni na sammāpariseditāni na sammāparibhāvitāni
an7.71:2.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an7.71:2.4: aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbijjeyyunti
an7.71:2.5: athakho abhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbijjituṃ
an7.71:2.7: tathāhamūni bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni na sammāadhisayitāni na sammāpariseditāni na sammāparibhāvitāni evameva
an7.71:2.8: kho bhikkhave bhāvanaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
an7.71:2.9: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti
an7.71:2.10: athakhvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati
an7.71:2.14: catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.

an7.71:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave balabhaṇḍassa vā balabhaṇḍantevāsissa vā dissanteva vāsijaṭe aṅgulipadāni dissanti aṅguṭṭhapadaṃ no ca khvassa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti ettakaṃ vā me ajja tassa vāsijaṭassa khīṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā hīyo ettakaṃ vā pareti athakhvassa khīṇe khīṇantveva ñāṇaṃ hoti
an7.71:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti ettakaṃ vā me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā hīyo ettakaṃ vā pareti athakhvassa khīṇe khīṇantveva ñāṇaṃ hoti
an7.71:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya chammāsāni udake pariyādāya hemantikena thale ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni bandhanāni tāni pāvussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhāni appakasireneva
an7.71:6.2: paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanaṃ anuyuttassa
